archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Warmth, Craft & High Graphics)

entry_surfaces./: split layout — rich metrics & smart natural-language expenses banner left, today's chef menu + chore highlights right
entry_surfaces./login: split branded luxury entrance — warm culinary hero & positioning left, glassmorphic auth form card right
entry_surfaces./cook: immersive high-graphics full-width kitchen dashboard with hero image banner, serving scaler bar, and large checkable recipe cards
entry_surfaces./copilot: conversational luxury AI assistant with floating organic mesh backdrop, quick suggestion chips, and live streaming receipts/meal planner

high_graphics_rules: Layered atmospheric backgrounds: subtle SVG organic blobs (terracotta #C85A32 at 6% opacity and deep forest #245C3F at 8% opacity) with CSS filter blur(64px) to give a luminous, painterly aura.
Noise/Grain texture: A lightweight repeatable SVG noise overlay at 2.5% opacity across the canvas to eliminate digital flatness.

Custom decorative botanical & kitchen SVG flourishes: Handcrafted delicate line-art culinary motifs (steam curves, bay leaves, chef knife, spice bowl) positioned strategically in card corners with low opacity (12-20%).
Gleam and Tracing Borders: Subtle 1px gold/cream inner-bevel highlight on cards: `border border-[#E4DDD0] shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.8),0_10px_30px_rgba(36,28,20,0.04)]`.
Depth & Stacking: Elevate cards on hover with `-translate-y-1` and shadow lift to give tactile card-deck feel.

chart_styling.doughnut_category: Custom Recharts Pie with inner radius 68%, outer radius 90%, rounded corner radius 6px, and custom center serif metric displaying Total Spent in INR (₹)
chart_styling.budget_bar_progress: Layered pill bars with textured stripes or smooth dual-tone terracotta/forest gradients with % markers.

login_hero.description: Warm artisan dining table with curated homestyle meals, ceramic plates, and natural light

cook_view_banner.description: Fresh vegetables and aromatic ingredients cooking in a skillet on warm stovetop

recipe_vault_hero.description: Fresh vibrant culinary ingredients and herbs on wooden chopping board

family_dining_thumb.description: Homestyle culinary celebration at family dining table

app_shell.sidebar: Dark forest green (#112217) background with warm sand text, delicate 1px emerald border, custom HomeBoard crest badge, navigation items with hover pill glow and active terracotta pill marker.
app_shell.topbar: Floating glassmorphic pill bar with Home status indicator, Quick AI Smart Expense trigger button, INR Balance overview chip, notification bell, and user avatar.

Dashboard.structure: Asymmetric Bento Grid (12-column). Top: 4 Hero Metric Cards (Total Income, Spent This Month, Budget Remaining, Today's Cook Menu status). Middle: Spend Breakdown Donut Chart (7 cols) + Today's Menu & Cook Instructions (5 cols). Bottom: Quick AI Expense natural language input bar + Recent transactions table + Chores checklist.

Expenses.structure: High-graphics expense command center. Top: 'Magic Parse' natural language input box (e.g. 'Bought 2kg paneer and vegetables for ₹450 at market') that auto-extracts Category, Amount, Date & Tag. Middle: Filterable data table with category badges, receipt view modal, and inline editing. Right/Stats: Daily spending heat-map or cumulative curve.

BudgetAndIncome.structure: Interactive envelope-style budget visualizer. Category threshold gauges with dynamic color status (Green -> Ochre -> Terracotta alert). Income stream allocation simulator.

MenuPlanner.structure: 7-Day Weekly Culinary Grid (Breakfast, Lunch, Snacks, Dinner). 'AI Auto-Fill Week' button generating balanced Indian & Continental home menus. Instant 'Send to Cook' sync button.

RecipeVault.structure: Masonry card gallery of home recipes with prep time, spice level indicator, dietary tags (Veg, Non-Veg, Jain), serving scaler, and 'AI Recipe Idea from Pantry' modal.

GroceryList.structure: Auto-aggregated list from the active weekly menu planner. Categorized by aisle (Vegetables & Herbs, Dairy, Spices & Pantry, Household). Checkbox strike-through with estimated INR cost.

Chores.structure: Household chore matrix organized by frequency (Daily, Weekly, Monthly) and assigned family member/staff with gamified completion streaks.

AICopilot.structure: Dedicated Home AI Assistant. Natural language streaming chat: can answer 'How much did we spend on groceries last week?', 'Suggest high-protein lunch for Tuesday', or 'Log ₹1,200 for electricity bill'.

CookPortal.structure: Public simplified, distraction-free tablet/mobile optimized portal for the household cook. High-contrast large typography, today's meals by time (Morning, Afternoon, Evening), serving adjuster (e.g. 4 people -> 8 people with scaled ingredients), and step-by-step checklist with simple audio/visual confirmation.

Login.structure: Split branded luxury entrance with ambient kitchen photography, warm value proposition, and glassmorphic authentication card.

micro_interactions: Hover scale 1.02 on recipe cards and action pills
Subtle progress bar filling animation on budget gauges
Smooth accordion slide for AI recipe step details

rules: All normal text maintains at least 4.5:1 contrast against its designated surface token.
JetBrains Mono numbers have high visual distinction and strict INR formatting (e.g. ₹1,42,500.00).
Every interactive element, button, tab, and form input has an explicit kebab-case data-testid (e.g. data-testid='quick-expense-input', data-testid='cook-servings-increment').
All decorative SVG flourishes have aria-hidden='true'.
Forms use accessible Shadcn primitives with clear label association.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the established earthy greens (#112217, #1E3B29, #245C3F), warm cream (#FBF7EE, #F5F0E6), and terracotta (#C85A32) identity, while applying the user's explicit directive for an 'Extremely high graphics UI'.

Implement the full suite of pages: Dashboard, Expenses (with Natural Language AI parser), Budget & Income, Menu Planner (with AI week generator), Recipe Vault, Grocery List, Chores, AI Copilot, Login, and public Cook View at `/cook`.
Use INR (₹) formatting with the Indian numbering standard (e.g., ₹1,25,000) for all monetary metrics.
Deliver rich UI details: glowing glass cards, subtle background blurs, animated badges, interactive charts with custom earthy palettes, and seamless responsive design.
Ensure all interactive components and key metrics include clear `data-testid` attributes for automated testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Never produce generic, flat SaaS templates. Layer backgrounds with ambient glowing gradients and delicate borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous 2-3x spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6) to ensure the rich graphics feel elegant rather than cluttered.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography: Use Lora serif for all headings and widget titles to give high-end editorial culinary feel. JetBrains Mono for all numeric currency data. DM Sans for clean UI copy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_density: Balance high graphics with high functional density. Tables must be crisp, forms must be rapid to use, and AI smart parsing must feel instantaneous.
